reads.sell: A red Burgundy from the Côte d'Or, silky and fine, with red cherry, raspberry and rose over a quiet earthiness of forest floor. It is a perfect partner for roast duck, game birds or a mushroom dish.

why.grape: Translucent ruby, silky tannin and red fruit over earth and mushroom is Pinot Noir.
why.climate: Tart red fruit, medium plus to high acidity and moderate alcohol say a cool continental climate.

reads.region: Napa Valley (Carneros), Sonoma County and Central Coast
reads.sell: A riper California Pinot Noir, with black cherry, raspberry and a hint of cola and vanilla spice on a silky, generous palate. It is lovely with salmon, roast pork or mushrooms.

why.grape: Silky, light tannin under cherry fruit and a translucent ruby colour still say Pinot Noir, however ripe the fruit.
why.climate: Riper red and black cherry, medium plus alcohol and acidity that has eased to medium say a moderate climate cooled by fog off the Pacific.

reads.sell: A Willamette Valley Pinot Noir with red and dark cherry, rose and a forest floor earthiness on a silky, fresh palate. It is made for salmon, duck or wild mushrooms.

why.grape: Translucent ruby, silky tannin and bright cherry fruit over forest floor are the marks of Pinot Noir.
why.climate: Tart to ripe red fruit, fresh acidity and alcohol held near medium say a cool, maritime climate.
